name: CatCode Instalments with PrivatBank, mono, A-Bank for WooCommerce
author: CatCode

sections.description:
One payment method, three Ukrainian banks. The buyer picks the bank at checkout and sees how much a month the order costs.

PrivatBank “Payment in parts”: 2 to 25 payments, the buyer approves the contract on the bank’s page. Programmes II, PP, IA and PB are supported, pick the one from your contract.

monobank “Purchase in parts”: 3 to 25 payments, no redirect at all. The buyer approves the contract in the monobank app, while the shop shows a waiting page that completes the order by itself, or explains the refusal and offers another bank or payment method.

A-Bank “Pay in parts”: works like monobank, the buyer approves the application in the Abank24 app.

Features

  • Three banks in one payment method, the buyer picks the bank at checkout
  • The method title and description follow the banks that are switched on
  • “About N UAH a month” hint from the order total
  • monobank and A-Bank: confirm the handover of the goods, which starts the buyer’s instalment plan, by hand in the order or automatically when the order reaches the status you pick
  • Every PrivatBank and monobank notification is signature-checked
  • The order status always comes from the bank’s own status call, not from the notification
  • A repeated notification changes nothing, a paid order is never sent to the bank again
  • Order discounts and fees are spread over the product lines, so the lines always add up to the order total
  • Classic checkout and block checkout
  • Compatible with HPOS (WooCommerce custom order tables)
  • Bank passwords and secret keys are stored encrypted
  • Test modes on the banks’ public test stores: PrivatBank and monobank need no contract for a test

PrivatBank, monobank and A-Bank are trademarks of their owners. This plugin is an independent integration made by CatCode and is not affiliated with or endorsed by PrivatBank, monobank or A-Bank. You need your own contract with the bank to take real instalment payments.

Опис українською

Оплата частинами ПриватБанку, monobank і A-Bank в одному способі оплати WooCommerce. Покупець сам обирає банк у чекауті й бачить суму платежу на місяць. ПриватБанк перекидає покупця на сторінку банку, monobank і A-Bank — підтвердження в застосунку, а магазин показує сторінку очікування, яка сама доводить замовлення до успіху. Підтвердження видачі товару для monobank і A-Bank — у замовленні вручну або автоматично за статусом. Перевірка підпису сповіщень, звірка стану з банком, класичний і блоковий чекаут, HPOS, тестові режими на пісочницях банків.

External services

The plugin talks to the instalment APIs of the banks you switch on in its settings. Nothing is sent to a bank that is switched off, and nothing is sent anywhere else.

PrivatBank “Payment in parts” (payparts2.privatbank.ua)

Used to create the instalment application and to read its state. When the buyer places an order with PrivatBank, the plugin sends the store ID, the order reference, the order amount, the number of payments, the programme, the product names, quantities and prices (shipping as a separate line), and the addresses the bank calls back and returns the buyer to. The buyer is then redirected to the bank’s page on payparts2.privatbank.ua. The state is read again when the buyer returns and when the bank calls back. In test mode the bank’s public test store is used.

  • Terms: https://privatbank.ua/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://privatbank.ua/personal-information

monobank “Purchase in parts” (u2.monobank.com.ua)

Used to create the application, to read its state while the waiting page is open and when the bank calls back, and to confirm the handover of the goods (by hand in the order, or at the order status set in the settings). The plugin sends the store-id, the order reference and number, the order date, the buyer’s phone number (the bank sends the request to the app on that number), the order amount, the number of payments, the product names, quantities and prices, the callback address, and, only if you fill them in, the store name, EDRPOU and IBAN. Reading the state and confirming the handover send the store-id and the bank’s application ID. The Sandbox environment uses the bank’s test server u2-demo-ext.mono.st4g3.com and the pre-production environment u2-ext.mono.st4g3.com.

  • Terms (they include the processing of personal data): https://monobank.ua/terms

A-Bank “Pay in parts”

Used to create the application, to read its state while the waiting page is open and when the bank calls back, and to confirm the handover of the goods (by hand in the order, or at the order status set in the settings); the confirmation sends the store identifier and the bank’s application ID. The plugin sends the store identifier, the order reference and number, the order date, the point of sale, the buyer’s phone number, the order amount, the number of payments, the product names, quantities and prices, the callback address and, if you fill it in, the store name. The test contour uses midgard.a-bank.com.ua; the live API address is the one A-Bank gives you with the keys, entered in the settings.

  • Terms (section 4 is about personal data): https://a-bank.com.ua/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip there.
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Instalments.
  4. Switch on the banks you have a contract with and enter their credentials. To try the plugin without a contract, keep the PrivatBank test mode and the monobank Sandbox environment.

The shop currency must be the Ukrainian hryvnia (UAH): the banks take instalment applications in hryvnias only.
sections.faq:
Do I need a contract with the bank?

Yes, for real payments. PrivatBank issues a store ID and a password under a “Payment in parts” or “Instant instalment” contract, monobank issues a store-id and a secret key under a “Purchase in parts” contract, A-Bank issues a store identifier, a secret key and the API address under a “Pay in parts” contract. The PrivatBank test mode and the monobank Sandbox need no contract.

How is monobank different from PrivatBank at checkout?

PrivatBank sends the buyer to its own page. monobank and A-Bank send the buyer nowhere: the buyer gets a push in the bank’s app, and the shop shows a waiting page.

When does the shop get the money, and when does the buyer’s plan start?

monobank and A-Bank approve the application in the app, and the order is marked paid. The bank then waits for the shop to confirm that the goods were handed over: choose “confirm delivery and start the instalment plan” in the order actions, or pick an order status in the settings (Completed by default) at which the plugin confirms it on its own.

Who pays the bank’s fee?

At PrivatBank it depends on the programme: in II (instant instalment) the buyer pays, in PP and PB the shop pays, in IA the shop and the buyer split it. Your contract with the bank is what counts.

What if the bank’s notification never arrives?

The plugin does not rely on it: when the buyer comes back from PrivatBank, or while the monobank / A-Bank waiting page is open, it asks the bank for the application state itself.

Does it work for orders over 50,000 UAH?

Not with PrivatBank: that is the bank’s limit, and the plugin simply does not offer PrivatBank for such an order. monobank and A-Bank set the limit for each buyer.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes. The bank choice and the monobank / A-Bank phone field work in the classic checkout and in the block checkout.
sections.changelog:
1.2.5

  • Security & reliability: hardened verification of bank callbacks and the customer return (order-key check), and safer handling of repeated/late status notifications.

1.2.4

  • Fixed: deleting the plugin keeps its settings while another copy of the plugin is active on the site.

1.2.3

  • Fixed: when two bank notifications for one order arrive at the same moment, the order is changed once.

1.2.2

  • First release on WordPress.org.
